component.name: Fundus
component.summary: Capture anything. Let your AI maintain the rest.

description.p: Fundus is a personal knowledge and task system with a language model as its organising layer. You write a thought, a task or a fact in plain language; Fundus files it as a note, an idea, a task or a topic, tells you exactly what it did, and lets you undo any of it.

Everything stays on your machine in a plain event log. The model only ever adds; it never rewrites or deletes what you wrote. Works with OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, OpenRouter or an Ollama model on your own hardware.

ul.li: One capture box for everything, with dictation
Receipts for every change, with undo
Topics that gather notes and tasks as subjects recur
A conversation that searches your notes before it answers
Markdown export and a consistent backup at any time
